query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `track_earnings` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `trackId` int NOT NULL,
  `artistId` int NOT NULL,
  `downloadId` int NOT NULL,
  `downloaderId` int NOT NULL,
  `revenuePerDownload` decimal(5, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.50',
  `artistShare` decimal(5, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.30',
  `platformShare` decimal(5, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.20',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `track_earnings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `track_earnings_track_id_idx`(`trackId`),
  INDEX `track_earnings_artist_id_idx`(`artistId`),
  INDEX `track_earnings_download_id_idx`(`downloadId`),
  INDEX `track_earnings_created_at_idx`(`createdAt`)
);
